worker-r58d fixture: round-58 D-run worker-seat death chain (verbatim, read-only source).

Source: CI run 45812793849 (issue #929, round-58 D run), pulled once from CI
artifacts on 2026-11-26 into the local forensics corpus; that corpus is the
verbatim source for every file listed in the sha256 table below. Do not
re-pull CI, do not regenerate, do not edit: these bytes attest what the run
actually recorded. All consumers treat this fixture as read-only replay
data; tests that need a mutated copy must copy it to a temporary directory.

What it attests (the worker-seat death chain the pipeline must repair):
- worker session hslconv died to the 900s process wall mid-checks-run:
  droid exit 124 (GNU timeout), last stream event is the tool_error
  "Error: Tool execution was interrupted" (52-event worker-stream.jsonl,
  vendored whole).
- The CI-recorded worker delta (worker-delta.json, verbatim job-log
  "delta:" line) carries no death fact: {"pid": "hslconv",
  "result": "failure"} — no exit code, no timeout signal, no stream tail.
  worker-delta-wall-killed.json is the structured target shape (not from
  CI; the field contract for the F1 delta extension): session_outcome
  wall_killed / droid_exit_code 124 / stream_tail_marker true.
- prep merged the worker branch and re-ran both checks green before the
  session died: evidence/packs/hslconv/checks-exit.json (both exit 0),
  checks-output.txt (21 passed / 384 passed, 2 skipped), check-summary
  totals {passed: 384, skipped: 2}. manifest packs.hslconv: branch_present
  + merged true, pack.handoff + pack.status false, complete false —
  machine-verified work orphaned by the wall kill.

Vendored scope: hslconv one-round evidence members (manifest.json,
evidence/packs/hslconv/*, check-summary, pytest-output/exit,
candidate-branch, plan.json). The two sibling packs (radixsort, uuencode)
are NOT vendored — their sha256 keys stay attested in manifest.json
following the r53c attested-debt pattern (see
test_fixture_manifest_hash_lifecycle.py).

Used by:
- tests/test_worker_r58d_fixtures.py — fixture integrity, digest
  reconciliation, death-shape assertions, control-shape contrast
- downstream worker-r58d features (salvage guard replay, replan
  death-context attribution replay; same replay files)
